summary: Iteration 39: Card Analytics Upsell Banner, FeedSidebar Component, Premium Page - All 16 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Upsell banner shows 'Desbloquea Analytics Pro' with $4.99/mes text and Pro button linking to /premium. Blurred preview shows 3 locked items. FeedSidebar extracted component renders Tendencias, Personas sugeridas, and Quick Links (Guardados, Mi Perfil, Analytics, Premium). All sidebar links navigate correctly. Premium page shows 3 pricing cards with correct prices ($4.99, $39.99, $9.99). Card edit button navigates to /cards/{id}/edit.

Upsell banner only shows when subscription.is_active === false (line 187)
Upsell banner has Crown icon, 'Desbloquea Analytics Pro' title, $4.99/mes price text
Pro button has data-testid='upsell-premium-btn' and links to /premium
Blurred preview shows 3 locked items with Lock icons (Visitantes por dispositivo, Fuentes de trafico, Perfil de visitantes)
FeedSidebar.jsx exports TrendingSidebar, SuggestedUsersSidebar, QuickLinksSidebar, and FeedSidebar components
QuickLinksSidebar includes 4 links: Guardados (/saved), Mi Perfil (/my-profile), Analytics (/analytics), Premium (/premium)
Trending hashtags have data-testid='trending-{hashtag}' and link to /hashtag/{tag}
Suggested users have data-testid='suggested-user-{id}' and link to /profile/{id}
FeedPage imports and uses FeedSidebar component (line 16, 802)
PremiumPage shows 3 pricing cards with checkout buttons (data-testid='checkout-{package_id}')
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 39 verified Card Analytics Upsell Banner, FeedSidebar Component, and Premium Page. Key findings: 1) Upsell banner shows for free users with 'Desbloquea Analytics Pro' title, $4.99/mes price, Crown icon, Pro button linking to /premium, and 3 blurred locked items. 2) FeedSidebar extracted from FeedPage with TrendingSidebar, SuggestedUsersSidebar, QuickLinksSidebar components. 3) QuickLinksSidebar has 4 links: Guardados, Mi Perfil, Analytics, Premium. 4) All sidebar links navigate correctly (trending hashtags to /hashtag/{tag}, suggested users to /profile/{id}). 5) Premium page shows 3 packages with checkout buttons. 6) Card edit button navigates to /cards/{id}/edit. 7) /payment/success and /payment/cancel routes render PremiumPage.
